description:
intent=i010 snapshot=s04 branch=expand-cow-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c:47-68 confidence=medium conclusion=mlx5e_ipsec_remove_trailer keeps ipv6_hdr/ip_hdr pointers across pskb_trim, which frees the old head for a cloned skb, so the post-trim tot_len/payload_len writes hit freed memory (stale-pointer UAF write).
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/emulex/benet/be_main.c:1146-1157 confidence=medium conclusion=be_lancer_xmit_workarounds captures veh from the skb head at entry and reads veh->h_vlan_proto after pskb_trim, which can free the old head for a cloned skb, giving a stale-pointer UAF read on short padded TX frames.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/intel/i40e/i40e_txrx.c:3050 conclusion=Verify whether i40e's vhdr points into the skb head and is dereferenced after skb_cow_head at i40e_txrx.c:3050; if so it is the same stale-header-pointer UAF.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ixgbe/ixgbe_main.c:9461 conclusion=Read ixgbe_main.c:9415-9500 to confirm whether vhdr survives skb_cow_head and is dereferenced afterwards.
unresolved location=net/mpls/mpls_iptunnel.c:108 conclusion=Check whether ttl in mpls_iptunnel.c is a pointer into the skb head that is used after skb_cow_head at line 108.
coverage_gap=Plain `ptr = skb->data + off` derivations and bare skb_trim() (not pskb_trim) were not enumerated by the scanner/greps, so the net/appletalk/ddp.c skb_trim pattern documented for s01 in fact f002 was never verified in s04.
coverage_gap=i40e_txrx.c:3050, ixgbe_main.c:9461 and mpls_iptunnel.c:108 flagged vhdr/ttl uses after skb_cow_head but were not read to a conclusion before the session finalize limit.
coverage_gap=Only net/ and drivers/net/ were searched (per branch instructions); helper uses elsewhere (e.g., netfilter core, wireless stacks under drivers/net/wireless beyond grep hits) were triaged only through grep line counts, not full reads.
limitation=No build or KASAN harness was run; the head reallocation on each reported path is inferred from the skb_cloned() branch of ___pskb_trim (net/core/skbuff.c:2721-2723) and pskb_expand_head's alloc-copy-free of the old head (net/core/skbuff.c:2285-2363) rather than observed.
limitation=Both findings require a cloned skb at trim time; on common TX paths skbs may already be uncloned, in which case the stale pointer still aliases valid (unmodified) memory and the issue is latent.
limitation=The caller path of mlx5e_ipsec_remove_trailer (which mlx5e IPsec/esw TX or RX entry invokes it, and whether those skbs can be cloned) was not re-verified in the final pass, so reachability rests on the function's own code.
limitation=The function-extent scanner matches derivations only through named accessors/function calls and one-line statements, so multi-line pointer arithmetic derivations may have been missed; 33 flagged triples were triaged, not all 559 grep hits.
artifact=findings/i010.json
